name: Simitone
description:
Simitone is an open-source 3D reimplementation of The Sims 1. Built on the FreeSO engine, it transforms the classic isometric life simulator into an interactive 3D environment with smooth camera controls.

Features:
- True 3D perspective camera allowing free rotation, panning, and first-person views
- High-resolution rendering with dynamic lighting and enhanced visual effects
- Full compatibility with original The Sims 1 base game and expansions
- Enhanced user interface scaling and modern widescreen display support
- Requires original The Sims 1 installation files to play
